data.exact_reserve_text:
The reserves established in 2020 have proved to be adequate and we have been able to make releases during 2021, especially on the 2018 and 2019 years of account, which are now reinsured under a Loss Portfolio Transfer arrangement.
An LPT has been put into place in December 2021 reinsuring the loss reserves on the 2018 and 2019 years of account to Medical Professional Mutual Insurance Company. This will provide stability to the Syndicate on any future loss movements on the prior years. The premium cost to the Syndicate was GBP 28.0m which provided an equivalent reinsurance recovery.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reinsured the loss reserves on the 2018 and 2019 years of account to Medical Professional Mutual Insurance Company; provided stability to the Syndicate on future loss movements and generated a reinsurance recovery included within net technical provisions of GBP 28.0m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported favourable prior-year reserve development during 2021, driven by adequate reserves set in 2020 and subsequent releases, particularly on the 2018 and 2019 years of account. Those prior-year reserves were reinsuring via a Loss Portfolio Transfer in December 2021, producing a reinsurance recovery disclosed as GBP 28.0m. Overall this resulted in a net release of gross claims reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) was not explicitly reported as a single gross movement figure. PYD was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative estimates) on page 31, summing movements for underwriting years up to 2019. The December 2021 Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) and associated reinsurance recovery (GBP 28.0m) may distort comparability between gross and net movements; the LPT affects reinsurance recoveries rather than gross booked claim amounts, but timing may influence triangle comparability.
